nom: ANUA KPop Demon Hunters Vita Brightening Collagen Mask

avis.texte: is the only review I've ever written to show how good this product is! I love huntrix, I love anua, and these are the BEST masks ive ever tried!
Honestly, I tried this because I love K-pop demon hunters and so did my kids, and it turned out to be one of my favorite masks ever!! my skin felt and looked incredible the next morning!!
I definitely will be buying this again. It made my face so hydrated and shiny. Loved how it made my gace feel.

Tried this just out of the blue- firstly the mask itself is beautiful!! And it is very hydrating- skin felt fresh and plump- and i love the seperate sections for the top part and bottom part of the face!
I do a mask at least once a week and tried these out. the color is a lot of fun. didn't bother my face. I have sensitive skin so it's always a risk. my skin felt soft after. glad to have tried them
